scope: Selected India regulated-profession credentials; this registry does not verify a person's current registration or right to practise.

rows.regulatory_effect: Certification requirement for specified associated persons under SEBI Research Analysts Regulations; does not itself establish SEBI registration or current authority to practise.
rows.evidence: NISM says the certification is required for the relevant associated-person category and remains valid for three years. SEBI separately states that a person acting as a research analyst/research entity generally needs registration unless an exemption applies. Do not infer expiry from a resume date or registration from the certification claim.

rows.credential: NISM-Series-XXV-A: Persons Associated with Research Services (Sales and Other Non-Core Services) Certification Examination
aliases: Persons Associated with Research Services certification
rows.profession: research-services associated person performing sales or other non-core services
rows.regulatory_effect: Role-limited certification requirement for PARS performing sales and other non-core services; does not itself establish SEBI registration or current authority to practise.
rows.evidence: SEBI's March 11, 2026 circular assigns Series XXV-A to PARS performing sales/non-core services and retains Series XV for other PARS; holders of Series XV as of the circular date need XXV-A only after the Series XV certificate expires. NISM lists a three-year validity. Role category and transition status cannot be inferred from the certificate string alone.
